title: Capture header
description: The header of a capture file: line 1, one JSON object whose keys follow the order of the fields.

schema.description: The schema id, `houserules/capture@1.0.0` when `capture` writes it.

cwd.description: The absolute current directory of the run.

start.description: The start of the run: RFC 3339 in UTC with nine fractional digits.

end.description: The end of the run, in the form of `start`.

exit.description: The exit code, or `null` when a signal ended the command.

signal.description: The signal number that ended the command, or `null`.

head.description: The full sha of HEAD, or `null` outside a git work tree (a `.git` directory and a bare repository count as outside), before the first commit, and when `git status` fails.

dirty.description: Whether `git status --porcelain` printed a line; `null` exactly when `head` is `null`.

lossy.description: The number of byte sequences that were not UTF-8 and that `capture` replaced with U+FFFD.
